reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: `type: opa` authorization still works but will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Use `type: custom` authorization to keep using the Open Policy Agent authorizer.

proposed.statement: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) is deprecated and will be removed in the future; `type: custom` authorization can be used instead.
